entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Basilica of St. Cunibert or St. Kunibert is the last of Cologne's twelve Romanesque churches to be built. It was consecrated in 1247, one year before work on the Gothic Cologne Cathedral began. It was declared a minor basilica in 1998 by Pope John Paul II.
